Context: 3. Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs)

## 3. Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs)  
This reservation benefit will be effective in Direct Recruitment vacancies  
to be notified on or after 1-2-2019.  
1. Percentage of Reservation.10% Reservation in direct recruitment in civil posts and services in the Government of India to EWSs who are not covered under the scheme of reservation for SCs, STs and OBCs.
